paragraphs.text: Organisers and police often give crowd figures that differ by a factor of three. Neither side is necessarily lying: they count different areas and use different assumptions about how closely people stand.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: A simple method gives better numbers. A photograph from above is divided into squares; people are counted in a few squares and the result is scaled up, with dense and empty areas treated separately.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Phones offer another way, though a rough one. Networks know how many devices are in a cell, but children have no phones, some people carry two, and tourists use foreign networks.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Accurate figures matter beyond argument. Planners use them to decide how many exits a square needs, and a march counted twice as large as it was can change how a city writes its rules.
paragraphs.label: D

items.quote: children have no phones, some people carry two, and tourists use foreign networks
items.prompt: reasons why data from devices is unreliable

explanation.en: Children, second phones and tourists make the data rough — paragraph C.
explanation.kk: Балада телефон жоқ, екеуін ұстайтындар, туристер — C абзацы.
explanation.ru: Дети без телефонов, двойные аппараты, туристы — абзац C.

items.quote: Planners use them to decide how many exits a square needs
items.prompt: a consequence for the way a city is planned

explanation.en: The figures decide how many exits a square needs — paragraph D.
explanation.kk: Сандарға қарап алаңға қанша шығыс керегін шешеді — D абзацы.
explanation.ru: По числам решают, сколько выходов нужно площади — абзац D.

items.quote: they count different areas and use different assumptions
items.prompt: why two official figures can both be honest

explanation.en: They count different areas with different assumptions — paragraph A.
explanation.kk: Әртүрлі аумақты санап, тығыздықты басқаша бағалайды — A абзацы.
explanation.ru: Считают разные участки и по-разному оценивают плотность — абзац A.

items.quote: A photograph from above is divided into squares
items.prompt: a description of counting from a picture

explanation.en: The photograph is divided into squares — paragraph B.
explanation.ru: Снимок делят на квадраты — абзац B.
